WITH status_averages AS (
  SELECT t.equipstatus, AVG(s.pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate
  FROM signals AS s
  INNER JOIN telescopes AS t
    ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  WHERE s.pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY t.equipstatus
), first_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_rate
  FROM status_averages
), above_first AS (
  SELECT a.equipstatus, a.avg_pulse_rate,
         a.avg_pulse_rate - m.mean_rate AS excess_first
  FROM status_averages AS a
  CROSS JOIN first_mean AS m
  WHERE a.avg_pulse_rate > m.mean_rate
), second_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_rate
  FROM above_first
), final_statuses AS (
  SELECT a.avg_pulse_rate, a.excess_first,
         a.avg_pulse_rate - m.mean_rate AS excess_second
  FROM above_first AS a
  CROSS JOIN second_mean AS m
  WHERE a.avg_pulse_rate > m.mean_rate
)
SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS average_pulse_rate,
       AVG(excess_first) AS average_excess_over_first_mean,
       AVG(excess_second) AS average_excess_over_second_mean
FROM final_statuses;
